definitions: A virtual machine that is exclusively allocated to a single user, customer, or application, ensuring dedicated resources and isolation.
A virtual machine instance where all underlying physical resources (CPU, memory, storage) are reserved for its sole use, not shared with other virtual machines.
examples: Our new project requires a dedicated VM for optimal performance.
We opted for a dedicated VM to enhance security and resource availability.
Setting up a dedicated VM can be more costly but offers greater control.
